bio.text: My name is Amber D. Johnson. I am a licensed Esthetician. I was literally birthed into the beauty industry. My Mother is a licensed Cosmetologist with 44 plus years experience and I was raised in beauty salons all my life. My passion for skin care began when I was 14 years old and from then on I knew what I wanted to do.
bio.note: Her own page says 17 years; the flyer says 19. The flyer is rank 1 and newer. Do not quote a year count from this bio.
